procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio review of only the explicitly pinned inputs. Verified all 33 listed file hashes and byte counts and all 15 PNG headers against packet dimensions. Read the complete packet, case, review rules, rubric, ratio policy, recording addendum, README and adapter; read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before opening posters, without following their embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets and no protected layouts, so both source receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and visually inspected the exact poster assets with tools.view_image(detail="original") and displayed each image with functions.exec image(), in this order: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. Completed all 15 displays before the first text-reading/transcription stage, mandatory judgment, rating or set judgment. Then read the two printable strings from the already displayed native pixels for each member in packet order and assessed usage and thumbnail behavior from the already displayed exact views. No ambiguity-triggered revisits were needed. No image edits, substitute assets, producer records, peer reviews, spawned/resumed/forked sessions or invented tool events/session IDs were used. This is a semantic viewing attestation, not a claim that hash verification or a helper exit proves visual inspection.
